info.tcb_info: {"app_compose":"{\"manifest_version\":2,\"name\":\"dstack-0.5.12\",\"runner\":\"docker-compose\",\"docker_compose_file\":\"# Docker Compose configuration for Cloud API in a VPC environment\\n# This setup includes the dstack-service for VPC management and an init container\\n# to prepare necessary configuration files before starting the Cloud API service.\\n\\nservices:\\n  \\n  # OpenTelemetry collector sidecar for in-CVM logs/metrics/traces.\\n  otelcol-contrib:\\n    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib@sha256:85ac41c2db88d0df9bd6145e608a3cb023f5d8443868adbfbbf66efb51087917\\n    container_name: otelcol-contrib\\n    command: [\\\"--config=/etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml\\\"]\\n    user: \\\"0:0\\\"\\n    mem_limit: \\\"512m\\\"\\n    environment:\\n      - MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN=${MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN}\\n      - CVM_NAME=${CVM_NAME}\\n      - CVM_HOST=${CVM_HOST}\\n      - DD_HOSTNAME=${DD_HOSTNAME}\\n      - ENV=${ENV}\\n      - CVM_HOSTMETRICS_ROOT_PATH=/hostfs\\n      \\n    expose:\\n      - \\\"4317\\\"\\n      - \\\"4318\\\"\\n    volumes:\\n      # Required for Prometheus docker_sd_configs. The scrape rules below only\\n      # keep containers explicitly labeled nearai.otel.scrape=true.\\n      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro\\n      # Required for CVM guest hostmetrics parity. OTel prefixes host mount\\n      # points with root_path=/hostfs so the collector reports the guest host,\\n      # not the collector container filesystem.\\n      - /:/hostfs:ro\\n      - /var/lib/docker/containers:/var/lib/docker/containers:ro\\n      \\n      - otelcol-identity:/telemetry:ro\\n      \\n      - otelcol-storage:/var/lib/otelcol-contrib\\n    configs:\\n      - source: otelcol_cvm_config\\n        target: /etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml\\n        mode: 0444\\n    \\n    # Identity-enabled CVMs declare their startup prerequisites through\\n    # cvm_telemetry_depends_on_config.\\n    depends_on:\\n        api-init:\\n          condition: service_completed_successfully\\n\\n    \\n    restart: unless-stopped\\n    # Avoid the collector tailing its own Docker JSON log and creating a\\n    # feedback loop. The host-side Phase 1 collector still captures VM\\n    # serial/stderr if this sidecar itself needs debugging.\\n    logging:\\n      driver: \\\"local\\\"\\n      options:\\n        max-size: \\\"20m\\\"\\n        max-file: \\\"3\\\"\\n\\n\\n  # VPC Services Definition\\n  dstack-vpc-client:\\n    image: nearaidev/dstack-vpc-client@sha256:dd570dee92901c6d9cf96909404bb5177294437e3642541225a85b06cefa3d9d\\n    container_name: dstack-vpc-client\\n    restart: on-failure\\n    cap_add:\\n      - NET_ADMIN\\n      - SYS_MODULE\\n    devices:\\n      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun\\n    network_mode: host\\n    volumes:\\n      - vpc_shared:/shared\\n      - vpc_node_data:/var/lib/tailscale\\n      - /var/run:/var/run\\n      - /dstack:/dstack\\n    environment:\\n      - NODE_NAME=cloud-api-prod\\n      - TUN_DEV_NAME=tailscale1\\n      - VPC_SERVER_APP_ID=e78c12915ad57900317b97bd16f59ae13f86f148\\n      - DSTACK_MESH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9090\\n    healthcheck:\\n      test: [\\\"CMD\\\", \\\"tailscale\\\", \\\"status\\\"]\\n    labels:\\n      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{\\\"source\\\": \\\"dstack-vpc-client\\\", \\\"service\\\": \\\"dstack-vpc-client\\\"}]'\\n    logging:\\n      driver: \\\"json-file\\\"\\n      options:\\n        max-size: \\\"100m\\\"\\n        max-file: \\\"10\\\"\\n        labels: \\\"com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service\\\"\\n\\n\\n  dstack-service-mesh:\\n    image: nearaidev/dstack-vpc@sha256:7a2de4eb94f6cc418b6c5ffbe819a719c7e9b86ab1b94b0c77902bc8690532cc\\n    container_name: dstack-service-mesh\\n    restart: on-failure\\n    ports:\\n      - \\\"443:443\\\"\\n      # Node-local outbound helper (client proxy), for the local client\\n      # only.
